method: from every surface sample a ray is cast along the inward normal and the distance to the first face it meets is the local thickness (mesh first, then the same ray on the exact solid for every candidate). deviations.reason: rev C YAML specifies the slot (base_plate.pad_holes.form: slot)

deviations.requirement: blind seats for the 1.0 mm balls (rev B)
deviations.implemented: three dia 1.15 through holes; balls set 0.1 proud on a gauge plate and potted with UV epoxy
deviations.reason: rev C YAML specifies through holes and the gauge-plate process; the conical seats are removed

deviations.requirement: baffle ring about dia 5.4, wall 0.6 (rev B task text)
deviations.implemented: inner dia 5.91, wall 0.8, spokes at [90, 225, 315] deg
deviations.reason: rev C YAML carries these numbers (base_plate.baffle)

deviations.requirement: every printed wall >= 0.8 mm
deviations.implemented: the wall behind each window recess in front of the camera cube is 0.525 mm: z 4.2..4.6 across the 4.0 mm bay (1.6 mm2 per camera); the bonded window backs it
deviations.reason: visor face 18.4 to cube front 17.075 leaves 1.325 mm for recess 0.55 + wall 0.8 + clearance 0.25. Accepted in rev C (visor_window.min_wall_behind_recess = 0.525)

deviations.requirement: camera opening bevelled wider toward the inside
deviations.implemented: no bevel: the opening is straight, +-2.0 wide and z 4.6..6.8, through the full 0.8 mm of wall, flush with the bay walls (bay half-width 2.0)
deviations.reason: the light bundle diverges outward: it is +-1.62 mm wide at the aperture and only about +-1.23 at the inner face, so a bevel toward the inside clears nothing. A wider bay would push the hood to more than the 2.85 mm half-width of the keep-out contract (hood outside is +-2.8). The straight opening also removes the thin bevelled rim of rev B

deviations.requirement: shallow glue channel if possible without going below the wall minimum
deviations.implemented: no glue channel and no glue chamfer anywhere
deviations.reason: the arc ledge is 0.65 mm wide and the seal land 0.4 mm: any groove leaves a seal lip below 0.5 mm, and a chamfer on the 0.8 mm visor wall leaves less than 0.8 at its foot. The 0.25 x 1.2 mm radial gap between base edge and side wall is the adhesive reservoir on the arc; the bead itself is 0.33 mm thick in rev C

deviations.requirement: two or three 1.2 mm locating pins/keys between base and tub
deviations.implemented: two tub lugs 1.2 x 0.8 x 1.2 mm under the visor wall at x = +-9.25, in base notches 1.7 wide
deviations.reason: no room for round pins inside the seal line (front strip 0.95 mm). The lugs interrupt the front seal land twice and must be flooded with adhesive (leak-test item)

deviations.requirement: vent pad near (17, -3) (rev B)
deviations.reason: rev C YAML gives this position

deviations.requirement: nose groove from the aperture edge to the visor
deviations.implemented: groove 1.0 x 0.3 from the cover-glass recess edge (r 14.25) to the visor; roof thickened 0.3 mm underneath
deviations.reason: the aperture edge is under the cover glass; the thickening keeps 0.8 mm under the groove

deviations.requirement: adhesive sheet at zero thickness in the YAML (rev B)
deviations.implemented: base plate 0.87 + sheet 0.13 (z 0.87..1.0); PCB at z 1.0..1.8; no modelling overlap
deviations.reason: rev C YAML: base_plate.thickness 0.87 and base_plate.psa.thickness 0.13

deviations.requirement: LCD glass assembled from below
deviations.implemented: glass is inserted biased 0.25 mm forward (against posts E and the hood rear walls) and then slid back: an assembly step
deviations.reason: rear glass corners are at r = 21.427 > ledge inner radius 21.35; biased forward they pass at r = 21.232 (0.118 mm nominal clearance, less than the print tolerance). Accepted in rev C

deviations.requirement: 0.25 mm clearance on every drop-in fit
deviations.implemented: PCB edge to seating ledge 0.25 mm; visor window in its recess 0.25 mm per side
deviations.reason: rev C YAML: pcb.radius 21.1 and visor_window.recess_w 5.5

deviations.requirement: light baffle from the visor wall back to each prism (light-tight)
deviations.implemented: hood: side skirts and a front pad down to z 3.0, rear wall down to z 4.81 (over the cube); bottom front edge of the rear wall chamfered 0.12 mm (0.26 mm to the prism hypotenuse). A slit of 0.25 to 0.37 mm remains above the cube at the rear
deviations.reason: the rear wall cannot pass the cube (LCD glass 0.63 mm behind it). Rev C: the slit is closed with a dab of black adhesive at assembly (README assembly step); the light-leak coupon test stays on the test list

deviations.requirement: top edge radius 0.6, bottom chamfer 0.3; cavity below z 1.2 = R 22 circle clipped at the visor face
deviations.implemented: radius and chamfer on the arc only (visor edges sharp); below z = 1.2 the side wall ends on the radial plane through the outer D corner (+-13.8, 18.4), which leaves an open notch about 2.0 mm wide under each end of the visor wall that the seal adhesive must fill
deviations.reason: the windows are flush with the top, a rounded visor edge would leave them proud; the R 22 circle meets the visor plane at 33 deg and would leave feather-edged wall ends; the radial cut keeps the full 1.0 mm wall at the end face

deviations.requirement: nest accepts the puck at 0 and 180 deg (rev B)
deviations.implemented: one orientation only; the D flat is the key
deviations.reason: rev C: the cradle is a charging and data dock; calibration does not use it

deviations.requirement: seven 2.0 mm pin holes and a stainless reference plate (rev B)
deviations.implemented: one printed slot 2.33 mm wide through the nest floor; no plate
deviations.reason: rev C: 'spring pins come up through one slot'; the reference plate is deleted

deviations.requirement: hold the marker down against the spring pins (open in rev B)
deviations.implemented: fixed lip (|x| <= 6.0, 1.2 mm over the tub top) and a rear cantilever latch (14.0 x 1.15 x 11.65 mm, hook 0.90 mm on the tub top) with a thumb tab
deviations.reason: designed and proven in check 7 (retention, strain, forces, posed insertion path)

deviations.requirement: four 3 mm feet pockets; PCB pocket underneath
deviations.implemented: four pockets dia 8.4 x 1.0 for dia 8.0 x 3.0 mm adhesive bumpers; PCB held against the pocket ceiling by four M2 thread-forming screws (not modelled; printed as dia 1.7 x 0.5 spot marks, drilled dia 1.6 x 3 after printing because a blind 1.7 mm hole would trap powder); three lightening pockets underneath
deviations.reason: '3 mm feet' read as 3 mm high bumpers (ambiguous); the pin force pushes the PCB out of its pocket so it needs positive retention

deviations.requirement: PCB located to the tub by two printed spigots in non-plated holes (rev C YAML)
deviations.implemented: spigots dia 1.0 x 0.6 under posts E in a dia 1.15 hole and a 1.15 x 1.65 slot: 0.075 mm radial clearance, as specified
deviations.reason: 0.075 mm is a locating fit, far below the 0.25 mm drop-in rule and below the +-0.2 mm print tolerance: a spigot that prints 0.15 mm oversize does not enter. The spigots are therefore a gauged feature (go / no-go at first article, dress with a hollow punch or fine file). Part B of PROPOSED_PARAM_CHANGES.md offers a looser hole with the optical margin it costs

deviations.requirement: cradle body 60 x 60 x 14 mm
deviations.implemented: body 60 x 60 x 14 (z -11.0 to 3.0); the lip stands to z 9.45 and the latch to z 11.28, so the printed part is 22.3 mm tall; the body is not centred on the marker (y -36.0 to 24.0)
deviations.reason: a hook over the marker top (z 7.6) with a 11.65 mm cantilever and a 30 deg lead-in cannot stay inside a 14 mm block; the rear needs the room for the latch well, the guard wall and the USB-C receptacle behind it

deviations.requirement: the marker rests on its three ball feet on the nest floor, pins at the working height
deviations.implemented: lip and hook have the 0.25 mm drop-in clearance above the tub top. With pins fitted the marker is pushed up against them: it floats up to 0.25 mm above its feet and the pins then work at 6.07 instead of 5.82 mm (0.89 of 2.29 mm stroke used)
deviations.reason: a 90 deg retaining face cannot preload a part whose height varies by the print tolerance; the float is inside the pin stroke. A dock does not need a seating datum (calibration is done elsewhere)

deviations.requirement: tub_keepouts is the complete contract: every tub feature that touches or hangs over the PCB top lies inside it
deviations.implemented: true for everything below z = 4.35 (2.55 mm above the PCB top), which check 12 proves on the solids. Above that height the tub still has features over the PCB outside the keep-outs: glass locating ribs down to z 4.75, the thick roof at z 5.550000000000001 (also behind and beside the LCD glass), the nose pad at z 6.5 and the vent pad at z 6.6
deviations.reason: design/check_layout.py lets a part outside the LCD footprint reach z = roof - 0.1 = 6.7. No listed part is taller than 2.0 mm there, so nothing clashes today, but the rule and the tub disagree: a free height must be added to the contract
